zh.night: 先看星点，再看光带：恒星自己发光，太阳也是恒星。
zh.stars: 换个位置看同一组恒星；一个亮点可能是没有分开的多星系统。
zh.milky: 太阳只是银河里的众多恒星之一；转到侧面看薄盘。
zh.neighbours: 同一把长度尺；星系边缘并不是硬壳，可单独放大看细节。
zh.inward: 保留地球定位，按真实距离逐步靠近。
zh.families: 这是不同恒星家庭的对照镜头；我们的太阳系是其中一种。
zh.outward: 尺度变大时，定位点可能代表整座星系。先分清成员与邻居。
zh.flight: 把前面学过的位置串起来；拖动距离尺或开始一路拉远。
zh.moonTitle: 地球与月球：仍用同一把长度尺
zh.moonCue: 地球和月球没有被放大；小圈是定位符，不是直径。
zh.inwardRuler: 从银河靠近地球 · 对数尺度
zh.stepChoice: 选择观察位置或相关对照
zh.sun: 近看太阳：它也是恒星。回到太阳系全景，再看它的位置。
zh.clusters: 左侧定位、右侧放大同一个星团；两幅图的取景尺度不同。
zh.sizes: 比较天体的直径，用「同尺核验」查看大小关系。

en.night: Stars shine by themselves; the Sun is also a star. Find points and the Milky Way band.
en.stars: Change viewpoint for the same stars. One light point may hide multiple stars.
en.milky: The Sun is one of many Milky Way stars. Turn edge-on to see the thin disk.
en.neighbours: One length ruler. Galaxies have no hard edges; inspect one for detail.
en.inward: Keep the Earth locator while approaching on the physical distance ruler.
en.families: A comparison window for stellar families; our Solar System is one kind.
en.outward: At larger scales a locator can represent a whole galaxy. Separate members from neighbours.
en.flight: Connect the places you explored. Scrub the ruler or play the whole outward journey.
en.moonTitle: Earth and Moon: the same length ruler
en.moonCue: Earth and Moon keep their sizes; small rings locate them and do not show diameters.
en.inwardRuler: Approach Earth from the galaxy · logarithmic scale
en.stepChoice: Choose a scale or related view
en.sun: See the Sun as a star, then return to the Solar System to locate it.
en.clusters: Locate the cluster on the left and inspect it on the right; the views have different scales.
en.sizes: Compare body diameters, then check the ratio on the common ruler.
